evidence_quote: propose a novel methodology that allows companies to naturally integrate an Energy Management System based on ISO 50001 into an ISO 14001 already in operation
Energy Planning (Energy Review, Energy Base Line and Energy Performance Indicators)

stage1.ineligibility_reason: Proposes a methodology/framework for integrating an ISO 50001 EnMS into an existing ISO 14001 EMS (standards compatibility analysis, integration diagram, documentary compatibility). No EnPI/EnB measurement model is identified or characterised; EnPI and Energy Baseline appear only as ISO 50001 requirement categories to be developed. Single kWh/produced-unit figure is a reported implementation outcome, not a characterised model.

paper_type.evidence_quote: these procedures were applied in a manufacturing company of the automotive sector

stage1.notes: Contribution is an ISO 50001/ISO 14001 integration methodology validated in one automotive (discrete-manufacturing) plant; energy-per-produced-unit KPI reported as an outcome, not modelled. Not a continuous-process sector.
